title: Sum the Supplies
description:
# Sum the Supplies

You counted the supplies in several chests. Given `nums`, return the total number of items across all chests. Do not modify the array.

## Example
Input: nums = [2, 3, 5]
Output: 10
Explanation: 2 + 3 + 5 = 10.

## Constraints
- 0 <= nums.length <= 1000
- 0 <= nums[i] <= 1000
- An empty array has total 0.

solutions.name: Running Total
solutions.description: Start with zero and add each chest count. Time O(n), extra space O(1).
